channel.title: AI-native biology, beyond the announcements · Alex Pico
channel.description: Updates on one thread: AI-native biology, beyond the announcements.

item.title: Article: Four AI-first drug companies, one quarter
item.description: Recursion, Relay, Schrödinger and Absci in the same reporting season: all are moving programs toward partners, dates differ, and almost no one names the benchmark behind a speed claim.

item.title: Table: Recursion: what it said it would do, and what it says now
item.description: A scored record of Recursion's dated statements from its own filings and calls: what it said, what it said later, which items were met, missed or stopped, and the dates still ahead.

item.title: Article: Recursion promised 100 drugs, then proof
item.description: Five years of Recursion's own words: it missed its original plan, has produced its first real clinical signals, and has not yet shown either beats existing care. A scorecard and a verdict.

item.title: Table: AI-native biotech observatory: plans versus later
item.description: A living record of what AI-native biotech companies said they would do, set against what their later filings say. First entries: Recursion (see its own page), Absci, Relay and Schrödinger, with a dated map of 41 companies. Work in progress.

item.title: Newsletter: When a company moves its own date: observatory issue 2
item.description: Three public AI-native drug discovery companies, three kinds of moved plans, read straight from their annual reports: Relay's runway, Schrödinger's narrowed and ended programs, and Absci's changed plan.

item.title: Thread: AI-native biology, beyond the announcements
item.description: What are AI-native biotech companies betting on, how do their approaches differ, and what changes as the work meets reality? A research series on the companies rebuilding biological discovery around AI: what they are betting on, how their approaches differ, and what changes as the work meets reality.

item.title: Table: Same shortage, different labs
item.description: Four AI-first drug discovery companies name the same shortage, accuracy in molecule design, yet own very different labs. A plot and table of what each says, with sources. Work in progress.

item.title: Newsletter: Same shortage, four different labs: newsletter issue
item.description: The short written issue that goes with the lab-ownership table: what four AI drug discovery companies say is scarce, and how their labs differ. Read online.
